persona_assignment_rationale: The persona is a 22-year-old white female working in retail in urban New York (a large city in the northeast), who is a regular news consumer and highly progressive. Variables chosen reflect race, sex, urban residence, region, employment status and sector, political views (liberal as proxy for highly progressive), and frequency of news consumption (once a day as a reasonable regular news consumer). Age is not directly available as a variable, so it is omitted.
